test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The role of the _________ is to recommend to the President measures needed to augment the Consolidated Fund of a State to supplement the resources of the Municipalities in the State based on the recommendations made by the Finance Commission of the State.

options.text: Comptroller and Auditor General of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Finance Commission.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Finance Commission** measures needed to augment the Consolidated Fund of a State to supplement the resources of the Panchayats and Municipalities in the State on the basis of the recommendations by the Finance Commission of the State.
 
• The Finance Commission is composed by the President under article 280 of the Indian Constitution, mainly used **to give its recommendations on the distribution of tax revenues among the Central and the States themselves.**
 
• **The finance committee was established on 22 November 1951.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NITI AAYOG stands for National Institution for Transforming India.**
 
• Its function is to encourage cooperative federalism by structured support initiatives and mechanisms with the States on a continuous basis, recognizing that strong States make a strong nation.
 
• The role of the Comptroller and Auditor General is to **audit receipts and expenditures of the Union and each State and the Union Territory Governments**.
 
• Finance Ministry is responsible for financial rules and regulations, financial sanctions relating to all Ministries and offices of the Government of India, 
 
• It also advises Ministries and government undertakings on Cost Account matters, and expenditure proposals relating to the Delhi Administration.
